fields.descriptionHtml:
Meet the Dripper D-02, a ceramic dripper sized for 1-2 cups that brings warm, straightforward pour over coffee to your home.

Why You Will Enjoy It

  • Ceramic material supports clean flavors in every brew.
  • Dripper design lets you control the pour for fresh coffee.
  • 1-2 cup capacity fits daily personal servings.

Key Specs

The Dripper D-02 is a ceramic dripper with capacity for 1-2 cups.

Everyday Use Cases

Use this ceramic dripper for morning pour over or quiet afternoon cups at home.

Built For Steady Brewing

The ceramic dripper form offers a simple workflow and accessible design for filters while delivering solid value for 1-2 cup sessions.

Care And Guarantee

Rinse the ceramic Dripper D-02 after each use to keep it ready for your next 1-2 cup brew.
